court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: Principal Sub Court at Vellore and Poonamallee (HMOP No.59 of 2021, HMOP No.454 of 2021)
facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2019 but are now living separately due to misunderstandings. The husband filed a petition for dissolution of marriage before the Principal Sub Court at Vellore. The wife is unemployed and cannot travel from Chennai to Vellore to contest the case.

legal_principles.principle: The domicile or citizenship of the opposite party is immaterial in a case like this.
legal_principles.held: The objects and reasons which prompted the parliament to incorporate such a provision has also to be taken note of.

legal_principles.principle: The residence of the wife determines the question of jurisdiction.
legal_principles.held: It is the residence of the wife, which determines the question of jurisdiction, in case the proceeding was initiated at the instance of the wife.

legal_principles.principle: The court should consider the difficulties faced by the wife in initiating proceedings.
legal_principles.held: Experience is the best teacher. The Government found the difficulties faced by women in the matter of initiation of matrimonial proceedings.

legal_principles.principle: The court should consider the wife's lack of money in initiating proceedings.
legal_principles.held: Where the petitioner's wife has pleaded lack of money, the same has to be considered.
cited_cases: Geeta Heera vs. Harish Chander Heera [(2000) 10 SCC 304]

legal_principles.principle: The court should consider the distance and difficulties faced by the wife in initiating proceedings.
legal_principles.held: Considering the distance and the difficulties faced by the wife, the Supreme Court has allowed the transfer petition.
cited_cases: Lalita A.Ranga vs. Ajay Champalal Ranga [(2000) 9 SCC 355]

outcome.final_order: The court granted the transfer petition and transferred the case from the file of the Principal Sub Court at Vellore to the file of the Principal Sub Court at Poonamallee.
